name: The Ritz-Carlton, Tysons Corner
positioning: Hotel next to the Tysons Galleria mall in Northern Virginia, with a spa and a Club Level on the 24th floor
best_for: Travelers who want a base next to the Tysons Galleria mall and a short walk to the Silver Line Metro
Guests who want a spa stay and a quieter, low-key setting

facts.text: The hotel is a short walk from the Silver Line Metro.
The rooms and suites blend style influences from Europe's cities with elements tied to Northern Virginia.
The Ritz-Carlton Suite has a primary bedroom, a living room, a formal dining room and a full kitchen.
The Club Lounge offers complimentary food and beverage presentations five times each day.
Club access requires an upgraded booking.
The spa has an indoor pool, jacuzzi, sauna and steam room.
ENTYSE, the hotel's restaurant, serves international cuisine.
Signature experiences include afternoon tea etiquette classes and visits to nearby wineries and distilleries.
Condé Nast Traveler lists a full-service day spa at the hotel.

highlights.text: The Club Level is on the 24th floor and overlooks Northern Virginia's most upscale shopping district.
Signature spa treatments include a cherry blossom body polish and a resurfacing HydraFacial.
The hotel is adjacent to the Tysons Galleria mall.
Afternoon tea is served on Fridays, Saturdays and Sundays, with piano entertainment.
The Dogwood is a private dining venue on the lobby level near ENTYSE.

considerations.text: The spa is closed Monday to Wednesday.
Self-parking at the hotel is paid.
Condé Nast Traveler says the hotel may not be around all the action but suits guests wanting something low-key or planning a wedding.
